svg.metadata: {"id": "s097", "name": "城市天际线", "cat": "自然与地理", "tags": ["地理", "城市", "社会", "美术"], "desc": "黄昏城市天际线：紫粉渐变晚霞，远中近三层楼群亮起点点窗灯，电视塔与拱桥，河面倒映霞光，近景滨江步道与路灯。", "stand": {"ground_y": 930, "x": [480, 1440]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "stars", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.25, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "city_far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "tv_tower", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "city_mid", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "windows_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "city_near", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "river", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.35, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}, {"name": "bridge", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.65, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "promenade", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamp_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "birds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 1.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#6D6BC0", "sky2": "#E59BB4", "sky3": "#FFD6A0", "sun": "#FFE2A8", "far": "#B7A6D8", "mid": "#8A7CC0", "mid2": "#7468AE", "near": "#56508F", "near2": "#46407A", "win": "#FFE08A", "win2": "#FFF3C8", "tower": "#E9B7C8", "tower2": "#C98DAA", "river": "#7E7CC4", "river2": "#F2B8B8", "bridge": "#3E3A6A", "rail": "#2F2B55", "walk": "#5A5490", "lamp": "#FFE7A8", "star": "#FFFFFF"}}
